name: Runway
tagline: AI video and image generation studio
description: Runway is a credit-based studio for generating and editing video and images with AI, with plans from Free to Max.
features: Credits for AI video and image models
Custom voice clones and Brand Kits on higher plans
MCP access on Pro and above
strengths: Annual billing lowers each plan's monthly price
limitations: Credits do not roll over on Standard and Pro
Credit costs vary by model (for example, Gen-4.5 is 60 credits per 5-second video)

plans.name: Max
highlights: 500 GB storage, early access to new models
plans.note: Unused credits roll over for one month

free.details: 125 one-time credits that do not expire, 5 GB storage, a selection of generative models.

api.summary: A developer pricing link exists but no figures were shown on the page we read.

pricing.regional: Currency shown only as '$'. Regional pricing and tax: not stated.
notes: Additional credits: minimum purchase of 1,000 credits; purchased credits never expire.

verification.notes: Product active. Individual tab: Free $0 (125 one-time credits, 5 GB); Standard $15 monthly or $12 a month billed annually (625 credits); Pro $35 or $28 (2,250 credits); Max $95 or $76 (9,500 credits, credits roll over one month). Team & Enterprise and API tabs not read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A creative studio for video, images and audio, plus an API for developers

capabilities.title: Generate and edit video, images and audio
capabilities.text: Runway Creative is a cloud-based workspace for all three in one place.

capabilities.title: Make and publish ads
capabilities.text: Runway Ads connects to Meta, Google and TikTok, generates on-brand variants and publishes the ones your team approves.

capabilities.title: Build your own creative apps
capabilities.text: App Studio lets you build custom creative apps with no code.

capabilities.title: Build with the models through an API
capabilities.text: Runway Dev is an API platform for developers, with models from Runway and other labs.

featureCards.name: Runway Creative
featureCards.text: The creative platform for generating and editing video, images and audio.

featureCards.name: Runway Ads
featureCards.text: Ad variants for Meta, Google and TikTok; the site says it is on every paid plan.

featureCards.name: Runway Dev
featureCards.text: An API platform with a Model Router, Workflows, Recipes and Characters.

featureCards.name: Runway Robotics
featureCards.text: A toolkit for running robot policy inference through photorealistic simulation.

audienceDetail.text: Runway Creative is for individuals and teams of all sizes.
Runway Dev is the API platform for building with the models.
Runway Robotics is aimed at robotics work and synthetic data.
The site says its partners include top brands, companies, agencies and studios.

scenarios.title: Produce on-brand ad variants
scenarios.text: Generate variations and publish the approved ones.

scenarios.title: Make video, images and audio in one workspace
scenarios.text: Keep a creative project in a single place instead of several tools.

scenarios.title: Build a creative app without code
scenarios.text: Turn a repeatable creative process into a small app.

scenarios.title: Produce output at scale through the API
scenarios.text: Call the models from your own product.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Try Runway for free button at app.runwayml.com, or download the iPhone or Android app.
Create a key on the Dev platform and read the documentation.

keyFeature: AI studio for generating and editing video and images
